instructions: A human entry records actor, role, active start/stop minutes, category, shared or arm-specific allocation, artifact, and correction reason if applicable.
An agent entry records system/model/version when available, task or prompt reference, tool activity, generated artifact, and human inspection minutes.
A machine entry records exact command/configuration, tool hashes, host, seed, caps, observed elapsed/CPU/memory, exit, and output identities.
Count setup, annotation, failed work, corrections, proving, validation, scoring, and adjudication.
Do not convert agent activity or manual-step counts into saved human time.
